title: 新时代的年轻人
en: Young People of a New Age

sents.zh: 一百年以前，中国有很多年轻人。
sents.en: A hundred years ago China had many young people.
They went to the new schools.

sents.zh: 他们学数，学字，也学西边的学问。
sents.en: They studied numbers, writing, and western learning.

sents.zh: 有的人去别的国家读书。
sents.en: Some went to other countries to study.

sents.zh: 他们看到了很多新东西。
学好了以后，很多人回来了。
sents.en: After finishing, many of them came back.

sents.zh: 他们做老师，做医生，也做事。
sents.en: They became teachers, doctors, and workers.

sents.zh: 他们写新的书，也说新的话。
sents.en: They wrote new books and spoke in new ways.
They wanted to make the country better.

sents.zh: 他们说，读书可以改变国家。
sents.en: They said that study can change a country.
